text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh no!
Your forehead's turning red!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I guess I really did eat too many Japanese sweets~. But they were all way too cute, I couldn't pick just one...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
They're smaller than cake, so
I just end up eating way too many~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black ended up getting rough skin.
